preprocessing.description: UTF-8 extracted text; use the pinned tokenizer, right padding and truncation to 128 tokens. Inputs are input_ids, attention_mask, token_type_ids in that order. Documents are unprefixed; retrieval queries use the model-card search instruction. No document bytes leave the producer.

producer.description: Specialize the dynamic ONNX graph to sequence length 128, select the first-token [CLS] state and L2-normalize it in the exported graph, as required by the pinned model card. Native variants must preserve this single embedding output.

evaluation.description: Minimum native-versus-portable cosine similarity on frozen English query and document vectors.
Minimum overlap with portable-source top-10 results on the privacy-reviewed in-domain holdout.
No NaN or infinite embedding component is accepted.

tpu.reason: Needs the fixed pooling graph exported as representative-calibrated fully-int8 TFLite, full Edge TPU mapping, semantic parity and Coral execution evidence.

npu.reason: The pinned ONNX source is portable, but the fixed pooling wrapper and NPU semantic/hardware parity have not been produced.

gpu.reason: The pinned safetensors reconstruct the reviewed BERT encoder for direct pnnx export. Installation still requires the bundled retrieval gate and named-Vulkan-device parity; conversion alone is not qualification.
